item.subject: Invoice NW-2026-09 for Lumen Labs: $7,021.44
item.body:
Hello Lumen Labs,

Your Northwind Cloud invoice is ready.

Invoice: NW-2026-09
Billing period: Aug 27 - Sep 26, 2026
GPU compute (benchmark cluster): $5,896.00
Hosting + egress: $1,125.44
Total due: $7,021.44
Due date: Oct 1, 2026

Payment details are unchanged (Cascade First Bank, account on file).

Thanks for building with Northwind.
Northwind Cloud Billing
